channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Carl Landry | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Carl Landry from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Elton Brand on Carl Landry
item.description:
Keith Pompey:Brand on practice atmosphere:

“It was great to be with the guys. Despite the record Carl Landry is diving on the floor in practice and guys are just playing hard. I wasn’t sure what to expect. It was good to see that.”

Elton Brand on Carl Landry, Jan 6, 2016. Source: Twitter @PompeyOnSixers.

item.title: Andrew Bogut on Jarrett Jack, Carl Landry
item.description:
Marcus Thompson:Andrew Bogut on Jack and Landry:

“In an ideal world, you'd like to keep both. But the reality is we probably can't keep both.”

Andrew Bogut on Jarrett Jack, Carl Landry, May 17, 2013. Source: Twitter @gswscribe.

item.title: Bob Myers on Carl Landry
item.description:
“But I called Mark (Jackson) and told him after the Carl Landry signing that he has something to work with this year. I don’t think he’s running from that challenge. I think he’s saying, ‘Yeah, we do.’”

Bob Myers on Carl Landry, Aug 2, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Jarrett Jack on Kenyon Martin, Carl Landry
item.description:
Jarrett Jack:

“Carl Landry is instant offense off the bench. We tried to get him to dig in a little more on defense, but he’ll figure it out. He sat next to me in the locker room, and he’s a great dude. I think he’d fit in well with the group.… We’d have to keep the leash attached, but Kenyon (Martin) is my guy.”

Jarrett Jack on Kenyon Martin, Carl Landry, Jul 13, 2012. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.

item.title: LaMarcus Aldridge on Carl Landry
item.description:
Aldridge disagrees.

“Landry’s a really good player and good players know how to fit in,”

LaMarcus Aldridge on Carl Landry, Aug 28, 2011. Source: SLAM.
